2.source: Outside Namekian villages, and in patrols around the Big Gete Star
2.translation: Fora das vilas namekuseijins, e em patrulhas ao redor da Estrela Big Gete

3.source: Marches on Namekian villages and fights their warriors; Novice AI
3.translation: Marcha sobre as vilas namekuseijins e luta contra seus guerreiros; IA Novato

4.source: Its hits launch you into the air
4.translation: Seus golpes te lançam pelos ares

6.source: '''Gete Robots''' are machines from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] that march on the Namekian villages of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. Their hits launch you into the air.
6.translation: Os '''Robôs Gete''' são máquinas da [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]] que marcham sobre as vilas namekuseijins do [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|planeta Namekusei]]. Seus golpes te lançam pelos ares.

8.source: While you are near a Namekian village (Ajissa or Sacred), small waves of 1–2 robots can appear outside it every so often, up to 3 per village. They walk toward the village center and fight the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]] on the way, who are their main target.
8.translation: Enquanto você está perto de uma vila namekuseijin (Ajissa ou Sagrada), pequenas ondas de 1–2 robôs podem surgir do lado de fora de tempos em tempos, até 3 por vila. Eles caminham até o centro da vila e, no caminho, lutam contra os [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Guerreiros Namekuseijins]], que são seu alvo principal.

10.source: Around the Big Gete Star, up to 2 patrols roam near players. Each patrol is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler|Metal Cooler]] scout leading 2–3 Gete Robots. The Big Gete Star's inner chamber is the lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] world boss.
10.translation: Ao redor da Estrela Big Gete, até 2 patrulhas vagam perto dos jogadores. Cada patrulha é um batedor [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler|Metal Cooler]] liderando 2–3 Robôs Gete. A câmara interna da Estrela Big Gete é o covil do chefe de mundo [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Núcleo do Metal Cooler]].

12.source: Gete Robots fight on the '''Novice''' AI tier. The health and damage above are their base values.
12.translation: Os Robôs Gete lutam no nível de IA '''Novato'''. A vida e o dano acima são seus valores base.

14.translation: Os Robôs Gete não dropam nada.

16.source: The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] asks you to defeat 10 Gete Robots in the Ajissa Plains of Namek, before you face Metal Cooler and the Metal Cooler Core.
16.translation: A missão da [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Saga de Filmes]] [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Estrela Big Gete]] pede que você derrote 10 Robôs Gete nas Planícies Ajissa de Namekusei antes de enfrentar o Metal Cooler e o Núcleo do Metal Cooler.
